summary: Explicit delivery of a capture to the active Aico session.

help:
Usage: selection [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Selection bus: send a capture to Aico.

Options:
  --install-completion  Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion     Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or
                        customize the installation.
  --help                Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  send  Type a capture into the active Aico session.
help.send:
Usage: selection send [OPTIONS] {kind}

  Type a capture into the active Aico session.

  Captures come from `st ui`; this verb sends one to Aico, which types it into
  the last-focused session. Exits 1 when Aico can't (no window open, a send
  still in progress, the session changing). Aico validates the kind.

  Examples:   st ui shot -w aico -o /tmp/x.png && st selection send region -s
  /tmp/x.png   st ui ocr aico | st selection send region --stdin

Arguments:
  kind  Selection kind: dom | a11y | region  [required]

Options:
  -s, --snippet <str>  Snippet text or file path
  --stdin              Read the snippet from stdin
  --meta <str>         Extra meta as a JSON object
  --help               Show this message and exit.

usage.when: type an authorized capture into the active Aico session
precautions: Types the content into the last-focused Aico session and exits 1 when Aico typed it nowhere. Effect metadata is not authorization to share content.
